mapper.sql: print_order_id, user_id, ebook_id, quantity, status, note, tracking_no, cancel_reason, needs_review, requested_at, updated_at

SELECT po.print_order_id, po.user_id, u.nickname, po.ebook_id, e.ebook_type, po.quantity, po.status, po.note, po.tracking_no, po.cancel_reason, po.needs_review, po.requested_at, po.updated_at FROM print_order po JOIN users u ON u.user_id = po.user_id JOIN ebook e ON e.ebook_id = po.ebook_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO print_order (user_id, ebook_id, quantity, status, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ebookId}, #{quantity}, 'REQUESTED', #{note})
INSERT INTO print_order_address (print_order_id, recipient, phone, postal_code, address, memo) VALUES (#{printOrderId}, #{recipient}, #{phone}, #{postalCode}, #{address}, #{memo})
mapper.select: WHERE po.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY po.requested_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE print_order SET status = #{next}, tracking_no = COALESCE(#{trackingNo}, tracking_no), cancel_reason = COALESCE(#{cancelReason}, cancel_reason) WHERE print_order_id = #{printOrderId} AND status IN #{s}
UPDATE print_order SET status = 'CANCELED', cancel_reason = '회원 탈퇴' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE print_order SET needs_review = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('CONFIRMED','PRINTING','SHIPPED')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM print_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CANCELED'
DELETE FROM print_order_address WHERE print_order_id IN (SELECT print_order_id FROM print_order WHERE user_id = #{userId})
